spec_match.rationale: Explicitly manual: points to chrome://settings/security, chrome://management, chrome://policy and chrome://version, and reads only navigator.userAgentData.mobile (relevant because the feature is desktop-only), never claiming to detect ESB.

interactive.rationale: Copy buttons, a userAgentData read button, and a self-report form with save, interpret, reload-restore and clear.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature index card describes exactly what the page does, including that it is a labelled model / manual observation where applicable.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers userAgentData absent, mobile true, localStorage throwing (try/catch on every access), empty submit (required radio), managed profiles and per-profile differences.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5094379441225728 plus the Chromium source or blog sources used.

conformance.rationale: This page is the named observation route for the esb-gated-server-scan manual assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153 (Playwright CDP) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch. chrome-devtools-mcp is NOT available in this environment, so there is no DevTools-MCP verification and no accessibility-tree dump. The copy button reported 'Copied chrome://settings/security'. The UA read returned mobile:false, platform Linux. Save interpreted correctly, survived a reload, and Clear reset it. Only the 2 expected panel warnings appeared.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the UA read and fallback branches and whether saving worked, without sending any self-reported answers.

design_system.rationale: Only public/styles.css tokens; buttons that override background also set color; status colours (emerald-dark, rose) used only on light backgrounds.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with labels, fieldset/legend, polite live regions and visible focus. However, the accessibility tree was not inspected with chrome-devtools-mcp, which is unavailable here.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Exercised at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800: 0px horizontal overflow on both after the final edit, single-column layout on mobile, 44px targets.

openQuestions.title: Observe a real managed ESB profile
openQuestions.detail: Run on a desktop Chrome 155 profile with SafeBrowsingProtectionLevel=2 to capture what chrome://settings/security and chrome://policy actually show, and add screenshots of the managed state.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live polite for standard status updates, reserve assertive for critical ones; label every control; visible focus; 24px+ targets (bumped to 44px here).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Readouts and verdicts are aria-live polite (never assertive); all inputs are inside <label>; :focus-visible 3px outline; buttons/labels min-height 44px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use visible radio buttons for 1-5 exclusive options, native checkboxes for multi-select, label every input, use aria-describedby for hints.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All exclusive choices (level, mode, platform, pipeline) are native radio groups in fieldset/legend; hints linked with aria-describedby.

guidanceConsulted.query: copy to clipboard button generated code
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Give copy buttons accessible names and announce the outcome in a status region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Each copy button has aria-label 'Copy chrome://…'; the result goes to role=status; failure tells the user to type the address.

summary: Honest manual-observation page with a privacy-safe local self-report.
